scientific_stage: M3-v2 tempered public-I1 Gibbs weighting after local-only concentration audit
v1_role: development result retained as a degenerate weighting construction; no graph simulation was run

temperature_selection.criterion: choose the largest beta such that provider-level ESS >= 3 for every provider
temperature_selection.rationale: M3 is intended to preserve and weight inverse ambiguity, so its effective provider support should not collapse below the three-representative support already carried by M2. Choosing the largest admissible beta retains the strongest public-I1 discrimination compatible with that minimum effective support.
temperature_selection.selection_evidence: public-I1-only local rescoring and concentration audit; no graph simulation and no graph WB were read

weighting.prior_mass: equal over the existing 48-point non-adaptive LHS support per provider
weighting.interpretation: tempered generalized-Bayes/Gibbs plausibility weight, not a literal posterior

next_gate: After V2 weights and the ordered 200-draw bank are materialized and hash-frozen, define the separate equal-budget graph contract for M3-200x10 versus M3-100x20.
